reading: Joined by the term Customers: BigCommerce's Customers V3 API, 'Create and manage customers' (BC-S-0197), and its scope Customers, store_v2_customers (BC-S-0199), name the store's customers as Shopify's Customers section (SH-S-1515) and Salla's Customers (SA-S-1693) do. Its finer statements are cited in the same tree: BC-S-0197's consent settings in CM-CUS-007 and its addresses, with the address webhooks, in CM-CUS-008.

Joined by the terms sign in and login: BigCommerce's Current Customer, which identifies 'signed-in customers' (BC-S-0202), and its scope Customers Login, 'Sign customers in to your storefront' (BC-S-0203), are the buyer's sign-in to the store, as Shopify's Customer accounts (SH-S-1490) and Salla's customer.login (SA-S-1609). The concern is coarser than single sign-on: its SSO statements (BC-S-0201, BC-S-0203, BC-S-0205, BC-S-0206) are cited in the child CM-CUS-011, and its login-access webhook (BC-S-0204) and Current Customer here.

Joined by the terms customer groups and segments: BigCommerce's plan line Customer groups and segmentation, 'Segment your customers for pricing, product access, and promotions' (BC-S-0209), and its Customer Segmentation API, 'Group customers into segments' (BC-S-0207), name Shopify's Segments (SH-S-1516) and Salla's Customer groups (SA-S-1845).

A reading, joined on role: BigCommerce's Price Lists 'Populate different versions of catalog pricing and assign them to different customer groups' (BC-S-0048), can be assigned to 'a specific sales channel, customer group, or customer group on a specific sales channel' (BC-S-0050), and the plan line's tooltip says they give 'B2B customers ... custom pricing at the SKU level for customer groups' (BC-S-0049); Shopify's Catalogs (SH-S-1529) are its 'catalogs with wholesale pricing' for B2B (SH-S-7212). Strained: a price list holds prices only, where a Shopify catalog also sets which products a buyer sees; and it is assigned to customer groups and channels, which no statement but the tooltip ties to B2B. BigCommerce's Customer-specific catalogs (BC-I-0506, B2B Edition's) are cited beside it. The reviewer may split prices from catalogs.

Joined by the term B2B: BigCommerce's B2B Edition, 'BigCommerce's add-on for business-to-business commerce' (BC-S-0354), which 'provides enterprise level B2B features' (BC-S-0356), is selling to business buyers, as Shopify's B2B (SH-S-0768) and WooCommerce's Marketplace category B2B (WC-S-0730). The concern is the whole add-on, coarser than the model: its finer statements are cited in the children, all in CM-B2B-001's tree: companies, users and addresses in CM-B2B-002, customer-specific pricing and catalogs in CM-B2B-003, and, in new capabilities, quotes (CM-B2B-004), shopping lists (CM-B2B-005), sales staff (CM-B2B-006) and the buyer portal (CM-B2B-007). B2B invoices and payments are BC-C-031's (domain C), not cited.

A reading, joined on role: BigCommerce's Promotions are its price reductions for buyers. Its plan line calls its 'more than 70 discount options' its 'promotions tools' (BC-S-0063, BC-C-010's); a promotion 'is composed of a condition that a customer can satisfy, such as increasing their cart value' (BC-S-0055); and the control panel's Marketing > Promotions holds a list Automatic (BC-S-0057), so promotions are coarser than automatic ones. Shopify's Discounts (SH-S-1522) and Salla's offer priority across offers and discounts (SA-S-1712). The Automatic list and the promotion's condition are cited in the child CM-MKT-003 as well, the same tree.

Joined by the term discounts: BigCommerce's plan line Coupons, discounts, and gift cards (BC-S-0063) and its Marketing APIs for coupons (BC-S-0062) are the store's discounts, as Shopify's Discounts (SH-S-1522) and Zid's plan line Discounts (ZD-I-0297). Strained: the concern holds three things, and its gift certificates and gift cards (BC-S-0062, BC-S-0063) are cited in CM-LOY-002, the tree of CM-LOY-001; its banners (BC-S-0062) fit no capability of D and are left uncited (scope.tsv names E under also). The coupons are cited in the child CM-MKT-002.

A new capability: BigCommerce's Product Recommendations, generated through Google Vertex AI (BC-S-0076) and queried for display on storefronts through the GraphQL Storefront API (BC-S-0080). No capability of the model so far is recommendations: CM-MKT-021 is upsell and cross-sell offers, which no platform's statement defines.

A reading, joined on role: BigCommerce's Subscribers API manages 'newsletter subscribers' (BC-S-0212), the people its store emails marketing to, as Shopify's customerEmailMarketingSubscribe records a customer's email marketing consent (SH-S-0881) and WooCommerce's customers' subscriber status in MailPoet (WC-S-5500). Strained: subscriber records are kept apart from customer records (their own API, BC-S-0212, and webhooks), and no statement says a subscriber is a customer, where the capability is customers' consent; Customers V3's 'consent settings' (BC-S-0197, BC-C-032's) is cited beside it, without saying what they consent to. No statement shows BigCommerce sending the newsletter (CM-MKT-007 is none-held).

Joined by the term wishlist: BigCommerce's Wishlist API, 'Create and manage customer wishlists and wishlist items' (BC-S-0214), names Salla's Wishlist API folder (SA-S-1140) and WooCommerce's wishlist (WC-S-5456).
